lines.text: Morning classes finish, and it's time for lunch.
Arcana takes out a lunchbox from her bag... no.
It's far too massive to even be called a lunchbox.
As soon as Arcana opens the lid,
I see rice balls decorated with cute expressions.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Don't they look delicious? And super cute too, right?
Just like Arcana said, the food looks absolutely delicious.
Did you make all of this yourself?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I woke up at the crack of dawn this morning to make it.
So that's why you were almost late?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I could do this with my eyes closed.
Arcana picks up an octopus sausage with her chopsticks and holds it out to me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Imagine you're a transfer student with an underclassman harboring unrequited love for you,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: who poured all her feelings into a lunchbox she spent all night preparing.
I pick up the octopus sausage Arcana dropped and put it in my mouth.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: S-sausages are just good to begin with!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: And I only grilled it. Nothing fancy.
I eat the sausage Arcana offers me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Sausages are good to begin with. You just have to grill them.
Arcana holds out a piece of rolled omelet.
it's safe to assume she made this herself.
Arcana makes a strange sound and puckers her lips.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I don't think I can control my expression.
Arcana feigns a stern look and starts feeding me the rest of the side dishes one by one.
After feeding me to her heart's content, Arcana finally starts eating.
If I want this to be an enjoyable meal, I should come up with a conversation topic.
Ask her what she wants to do.
I take out the note Arcana gave me earlier.
While we're eating, let's go through this together.
The list of things you want to do.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I've also got this, and this, and this...
A crystal ball, tarot cards, a camera, a knitting set...
Various books, a pair of glasses... Wait a moment, are those cat ears...?
... Anyway, Arcana lines up all sorts of items on the desk.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I think this covers everything we might need.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Are you having a hard time choosing?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Don't worry. I'll explain them all in detail.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That way you can pick what sounds good to you.
Wh-why are you taking this so seriously...?
Arcana's long-winded explanation lasts all the way until lunch break is over.
I'm so distracted I can't even tell what I'm putting in my mouth.
But at least Arcana seems happy...
Arcana raises her camera and takes a photo.
Come to think of it, you like taking photos, right?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yup. It's not really a hobby or anything, but it's fun.
Arcana takes out a camera that looks just like the one she's holding.
Without a word, Arcana looks at me and strikes a pose.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah. I'm giving it to you.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Let's make lots of good memories. Together.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hmm... I'm okay at it, I guess.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I can't really do anything super fancy, though.
Arcana picks up a slice of kiwi and holds it out to me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I can at least cook well enough that my future husband won't starve.
Arcana picks up a slice of kiwi for herself and eats it.
Then she absently bites down on her chopsticks as she thinks.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Being good at something and actually liking it are two different things, you know?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hmm... I've never really thought about it that way.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Could you tell me one more time that the food's delicious?
Without a word, Arcana puts the last piece of kiwi into my mouth and begins packing up the lunchbox.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... I just realized something for the first time in my life.
Arcana closes the lunchbox lid and pokes my cheek.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I guess I really do like cooking.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}. Let's go check out the clubs.
Before I even have a chance to think it over, Arcana drags me along, and we begin touring the clubs.
We start with the familiar ones: literature club, broadcasting club, band, art club, and so on.
The secret passage exploration club? What's that even supposed to be...?
Even the really bizarre clubs that shouldn't exist.
We end up checking out almost every club, but...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah... Nothing really stands out and makes me think, "This is it!"

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Maybe I should just join something decent enough and call it a day.
Why don't you form a club of your own?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I really do want to do club activities...
If nothing's calling out to you, then start something of your own.
So what do you want to do? A divination club, maybe?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: A d-divination club does sound nice. Or maybe a photography club...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: So if there's something I want to do, I should just go for it, right?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hmm... but juggling multiple things at once might be hard, right?
Well... it's not impossible, but you'll have other school events to deal with too.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Either a divination club or a photography club.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I guess I'll pick one of those two.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I honestly really like both, which actually makes it harder to decide.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: We already did a bunch of things from my list today.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Like heading back to the dorms together, while holding hands.
Arcana and I stroll slowly hand in hand
as I walk her back to the dorms.
